description: Apply chained text cleanup operations in sequence. Operations: trim, collapse_spaces, normalize_whitespace, remove_line_breaks, normalize_line_breaks, dedupe_lines, reverse_lines, strip_html, strip_emoji, strip_urls, strip_emails, normalize_quotes (curly → straight), normalize_dashes (em/en → hyphen), lowercase, uppercase. Returns cleaned text plus per-operation chars/lines removed.
name: text_cleanup
